resist.note: from nonmagical attacks that aren't silvered

trait.name: Hive Mind
entries: All fiendish formians within 1 mile of Ekengarik can telepathically communicate with each other and Ekengarik.

action.name: Multiattack
entries: The fiendish formian makes two Claw attacks.

action.name: Claw
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}7 ({@damage 1d6 + 4}) slashing damage.

action.name: Bite
entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. {@h}8 ({@damage 1d8 + 4}) piercing damage and the target must make a {@dc 14} Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the target's Strength score is reduced by 1. The target dies if this reduces its Strength to 0. Otherwise, the reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest.
